shared_elements: rows of repeated short strokes or notches
linear bands or elongated curved forms
small isolated human/anthropomorphic or figure-like marks
justification: The most specific correspondence is the use of schematic linear motifs with repeated short strokes attached to or set along elongated lines, plus scattered small figure-like signs. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by boat-like curved hulls, stick humans, and a dotted border, while B is organized into carved registers of animal/creature figures and bands without the same boat-and-human scheme.
